idea-plugin.name: wishlang
idea-plugin.description:
Create-from-usage for Java. Write the call sites you wish existed; Claude Code writes the code underneath, first as a skimmable prototype, then, once you are happy, as the real implementation.

  • Tinted code: everything Claude generated gets a gutter bar and a faint tint, stronger while it is still mocked.
  • Reasons on hover: who wrote a line and, for generated code, why and which of your edits triggered it.
  • Ticket tracing: generated code is traced to the problems of the branch's ticket; code that serves none is flagged red.
  • No false errors: Cannot resolve symbol is hidden for symbols you wished for; they show as will be generated.
  • Read as Pseudocode: fold any Java file, also in diffs and PR reviews, into one line per business step, and each method into one line.
  • Wish tool window: the journal of every cycle with diffs and Claude's reasoning, and the ticket as a problem tree.

Requires the wishlang command-line tool and Claude Code. If wishlang is missing, the plugin offers to download it. See xunrise.github.io/wishlang for install instructions and a demo. Rust is supported in Zed through the wishlang extension.

action.description: Fold each method into its business steps (expand a step to see its code); toggle again to restore
